01 / The idea

Henri’s brings the friends.
Le Gilda Club sets the scene.

Henri’s is gathering a small selection of brands for a weekend pop-up in central Luxembourg. Le Gilda Club is organising the event, bringing the space to life with a bar, music and places to sit, catch up and enjoy the weekend. Food will be available to purchase on site, provided by Scotts.

A shared setting where visitors can meet the people behind the products · and where each brand has room to tell its own story.

Meet Henri’s.

A clothing brand with its own character and a circle of friends. Henri’s anchors the pop-up, joined by independent brands with a distinct point of view.

Explore Henri’s

Welcome to Le Gilda Club.

Le Gilda Club creates social events in Luxembourg. Over several years, we have built a community around music, shared experiences and meeting new people. We bring that experience and community to this pop-up.

Discover @legildaclub
02 / The weekend

Come for a browse.
Stay for the company.

A pop-up woven into a full weekend of discovery, drinks and music.

Discover the brands up close.

Explore the brands, meet their founders and take a seat. Scotts will provide the bar and food available to purchase on site.

A little later, a little louder.

On Saturday evening, the space shifts into a Le Gilda Club DJ session, with the brand displays put away beforehand.

Friday / 23 October

Setup & guest gathering.

From 10:00, brands can set up their stands. During the afternoon and evening, as setup wraps up, invited friends and family are welcome to join the brands for drinks at the bar. A gathering for brands and their guests, not a public opening.

Saturday / 24 October

Day into evening.

Open to the public from 11:00 to 21:00.
DJ set until 01:00.

Sunday / 25 October

One more look.

Open to the public from 11:00 to 17:00. Revisit your favourites, meet the brands and enjoy the space.

Public opening: Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 October. Friday setup starts at 10:00, followed by an afternoon/evening gathering for invited guests.

03 / The setting

A little room
for everything.

Right in the centre of Luxembourg, opposite the Golden Lady: a spacious venue with a glazed indoor area, a covered outdoor space and an open terrace. Each area plays a part, from browsing the collections to taking a break with friends.

06 / Join the weekend

Let’s find
your place.

Which brands are taking part?

Henri’s is the main collaborating brand. We are building a complementary guest selection and will share the line-up as participation is confirmed.

Do I need to confirm now?

Contact the person who invited you to confirm availability and discuss participation. The fee is €169 for the full weekend, with at least 5 m² guaranteed per brand. Final stand allocations will be shared during the week before the event.

Who will sell the products?

Tell us whether your team can attend or whether you are looking for a consignment arrangement. We will discuss what is feasible before confirming participation; consignment is not an included service.

How do I get in touch?

Message @legildaclub or reply to the person who shared this invitation. Send your brand profile, product category, availability and approximate space needs.
